This page lists every setting on the pane, in the order Sift declares them. To open the pane, go to [Settings > Insights](/settings/insights).

## Every setting

<a id="insights.recap_day"></a>

### Create a recap of each day

The morning after a day with ten or more sessions, Sift creates its recap.

Recaps already created stay until you clear your history.

- **Path**: [Settings > Insights > Create a recap of each day](/settings/insights#insights.recap_day)
- **Default**: On
- **Who sets it**: each User, for themselves

<a id="insights.recap_week"></a>

### Create a recap of each week

On Monday, Sift creates a recap of the week before.

Recaps already created stay until you clear your history.

- **Path**: [Settings > Insights > Create a recap of each week](/settings/insights#insights.recap_week)
- **Default**: On
- **Who sets it**: each User, for themselves

<a id="insights.recap_month"></a>

### Create a recap of each month

On the first of the month, Sift creates a recap of the month before.

Recaps already created stay until you clear your history.

- **Path**: [Settings > Insights > Create a recap of each month](/settings/insights#insights.recap_month)
- **Default**: On
- **Who sets it**: each User, for themselves

<a id="insights.recap_year"></a>

### Create a recap of each year

On the first day of a year, Sift creates a recap of the year before.

Recaps already created stay until you clear your history.

- **Path**: [Settings > Insights > Create a recap of each year](/settings/insights#insights.recap_year)
- **Default**: On
- **Who sets it**: each User, for themselves
